resolvedFindings.resolution: The selected Vishnu-related analysis of ਅਭੰਡ now names Vishnu in both main meanings and preserves the separate indivisibility alternative.
Destruction of adversaries/the wicked is stated directly rather than limited to loss of their power. Contextual cautions distinguish Divine praise from human retaliation.
Ambiguous English unfashionable was replaced by language about a being beyond a fashioned image or unrepresentable being.
The added those who oppose You clause was removed; the source adversary term remains without assigning it to contemporary religious disagreement.
Complete being is the main reading of ਸਰਬਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ, explicitly following Sahib Singh; the all-form interpretation is separately identified.

The food/drink reading is retained with an explicit note that Sahib Singh reads ਪਾਨ through hand and explains sustenance in Divine hands. The reviewer also independently checked the displayed drink reading in the ShabadOS comparison text.
The summary now says the Divine does not depend on food, avoiding a separate claim about inability to be sustained.
Awkward ਉਸਤਤੇ/ਉਸਤਤੀ constructions were replaced by grammatical sentences about praise.
The main meaning directly states freedom from ritual dependence, without the added to establish Your being clause. Associated study wording was aligned.
Universal-form wording now mirrors the selected source; destruction of wrongful deeds is stated with clear Divine agency.
The English main meanings now preserve ਪ੍ਰਣਾਸੀ as destruction and ਗਜਾਇਬ as bringing wrath; compassionate descriptions and contextual cautions remain.
The ending remains exactly at the selected199 counter; unnecessary prose about adding unverified verses was removed.
Ancient source order was corrected to Selected source order. The selected ਅਗਾਹ/ਅਢਾਹ ordering is preserved without an unsupported antiquity claim.
